tbesh_html:
1) great, majestic
1a) of waters of sea
1b) of a tree
1c) of kings, nations, gods
2) great one, majestic one
2a) of nobles, chieftains, servants

strongs_1890.kjv_def: excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.

occurrences.bsb: But You blew with Your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
occurrences.kjv: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

occurrences.bsb: Then the survivors came down to the nobles; the people of the LORD came down to me against the mighty.
occurrences.kjv: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the Lord made me have dominion over the mighty.

occurrences.bsb: He asked for water, and she gave him milk. In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.
occurrences.kjv: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

occurrences.bsb: And he took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace through the Upper Gate. They seated King Joash on the royal throne,
occurrences.kjv: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the Lord: and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

occurrences.bsb: Next to him, the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.
occurrences.kjv: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

occurrences.bsb: hereby join with their noble brothers and commit themselves with a sworn oath to follow the Law of God given through His servant Moses and to obey carefully all the commandments, ordinances, and statutes of the LORD our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

occurrences.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
occurrences.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David. O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

occurrences.bsb: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
occurrences.kjv: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

occurrences.bsb: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
occurrences.kjv: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

occurrences.bsb: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
occurrences.kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

occurrences.bsb: Above the roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is majestic.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

occurrences.bsb: and slaughtered mighty kings—His loving devotion endures forever.
occurrences.kjv: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

occurrences.bsb: He will clear the forest thickets with an axe, and Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
occurrences.kjv: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

occurrences.bsb: But there the Majestic One, our LORD, will be for us a place of rivers and wide canals, where no galley with oars will row, and no majestic vessel will pass.
occurrences.kjv: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

occurrences.bsb: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water; their jars return empty. They are ashamed and humiliated; they cover their heads.
occurrences.kjv: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

occurrences.bsb: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For the days of your slaughter have come; you will fall and be shattered like fine pottery.
occurrences.kjv: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

occurrences.bsb: Flight will evade the shepherds, and escape will elude the leaders of the flock.
occurrences.kjv: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

occurrences.bsb: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the LORD is destroying their pasture.
occurrences.kjv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.

occurrences.bsb: Their leader will be one of their own, and their ruler will arise from their midst. And I will bring him near, and he will approach Me, for who would dare on his own to approach Me?” declares the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I will plant it on the mountain heights of Israel so that it will bear branches; it will yield fruit and become a majestic cedar. Birds of every kind will nest under it, taking shelter in the shade of its branches.
occurrences.kjv: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

occurrences.bsb: “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:
occurrences.kjv: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

occurrences.bsb: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.
occurrences.kjv: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

occurrences.bsb: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
occurrences.kjv: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.

occurrences.bsb: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen; the majestic trees are ruined! Wail, O oaks of Bashan, for the dense forest has been cut down!
occurrences.kjv: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
